findings.summary: validateSliceCorrection/activeSlice unbound slice_id allows validating a non-active ready slice
findings.evidence: activeSlice L606-610 and validateSliceCorrection L643-650 allow input.slice_id to target a non-active ready slice while lineage status is validating, then clear pending/active state
findings.why_it_matters: Allows marking an uncorrected slice passed and abandoning validation of the slice that actually received the correction delta.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Validation MUST bind exclusively to active_slice_id and pending_correction.slice_id; diverting to another ready slice MUST throw; covered by multi-slice regression test.

findings.summary: createSuccessor authority_kind only enforced for remediation-v2 predecessors
findings.evidence: createSuccessor L455-457 gates authority_kind only when isRemediationV2; freezeFindings attaches v2 only on opt-in; planLineageGate requires migration only for correct/record-correction/targeted-validation
findings.why_it_matters: Typed successor authority claimed by remediation-v2 can be skipped via terminal non-migrated predecessors.
findings.acceptance_criteria: createSuccessor MUST require allowlisted authority_kind for all post-rollout successors or reject non-v2 predecessors; terminate-v1 then untyped successor MUST fail closed in tests.

findings.summary: beginSliceCorrection accepts any ready slice_id, not only reducer-selected
findings.evidence: beginSliceCorrection L624-625 accepts any ready input.slice_id without equality to nextSliceAction(state).slice_id
findings.why_it_matters: Pure reducer authority does not enforce deterministic reducer-selected slice dispatch, enabling out-of-order remediation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: beginSliceCorrection MUST accept only the reducer-selected ready slice_id; out-of-order ready slices MUST be rejected with a test.
